changeSet.comment: A repository whose readers no provider listing can name, such as a GitHub internal repository, records READERS_NOT_LISTABLE and waits.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A reader of a monitored repository is removed in the transaction that records, from any path, that GitHub removed the person: a collaborator, a team member, a team's access or an organization member. A team or an organization is deleted only after these rows, because their keys do not cascade to them all. Every monitor of the repository moves its proof generation on, so a listing that began before the removal does not restore the person. A deleted repository drops every monitor's readers and proof. The narrowing that a repository turned private already makes also stamps when the proof changed.
